decisions: This repository is independent of build-a-web-page-for-ios.
Hardware target is original ESP32 integrated TWAI plus NXP TJA1051T/3 SO8.
ESP-IDF TWAI is the default firmware-framework recommendation pending version and installation inspection.
Default runtime state must be passive/listen-only with a hardware-enforced transmitter inhibit.
Vehicle CAN identifiers, bus bit rate, topology, and signal mappings remain unknown until supported by evidence.
Official public Labcenter pages reviewed did not confirm a Python schematic-generation API; verify installed documentation or vendor support rather than inventing one.
S00 cannot be closed until the user's actual development environment and exact ESP32 board/module are inspectable.
open_questions: Exact operating system, architecture and existing Python/Git/CMake/Ninja versions
Exact ESP32 module/board and accessible GPIOs
Available Proteus version, licensed features, Python automation path and official symbol/library availability
Verified bus bit rate(s), topology, protocol/frame format and safely available capture points for the target vehicle
Current local checkout status and whether it contains unpushed/uncommitted work
